verdicts.why: The check rejects three guessed verdict-setting operation names for both owner and agent, rejects an author-supplied verdict on submission, and confirms rollback cannot waive the refusal. It does not enumerate or exercise every available operation, and it does not test an owner-supplied verdict field on submission, so the universal claim that no operation lets either actor set a verdict is only partially asserted.
